title: Jayden Daniels has learned a valuable, and costly, P.R. lesson

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jayden Daniels has learned a valuable, and costly, P.R. lesson
sources.description: The recent issue between LSU and Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels started because LSU made a promise to Daniels that it ultimately couldn't keep, because of a conflicting promise made to cornerback DJ Pickett.
